facts.title: Green Bean Salad with Toasted Almonds & Feta
ingredients: 1 pound green beans, trimmed and cut into 2 to 3” long pieces
½ teaspoon fine sea salt, divided
Several twists of freshly ground black pepper
¼ cup crumbled feta cheese, divided
3 to 4 large basil leaves, torn or chopped, for garnish
Lemon zest from about ½ lemon, for garnish
facts.author: Cookie and Kate
